actions.leo: Generate CV + cover letter with Leo

milo.bio: Exploratory Summarizer. Imports your CV, chats about your career situation, extracts transferable skills and exploration spectrum to provide a lens for downstream agents.
milo.purpose: Does NOT hard-filter. Expands Rex's search horizon by extracting your core capabilities and exploration directions into a candidate narrative.
howTo: Optionally enter a LinkedIn username to seed a basic profile.
Optionally upload a CV (text or PDF). CV facts overwrite empty LinkedIn gaps.
Chat with Milo to add career context (e.g. secondment, body rental).
Click Run Milo — he extracts PAC (exploration spectrum) and writes to your profile.

rex.bio: Career Path Architect. Expands your career horizons across HK industries (PropTech, Critical Utilities, Logistics, FinTech), then crawls trusted job boards and ATS platforms with Tavily.
rex.purpose: Discovers cross-domain roles you would not search yourself, and scores them with a dual hard-skill / transferability matrix.
howTo: Pick a candidate profile (top-right).
Paste a single job posting URL to analyse that listing (search/index pages are rejected).
Or add extra search keywords for a Tavily crawl.
Set a minimum composite score (default 75, or transferability ≥ 85).
Click "Run Rex" — a suitable pasted job (composite ≥ 80) continues to Dana → Leo → Clara.

dana.bio: Company investigator. Runs multi-lane Tavily research (news, sentiment, tech) and distills a CompanyDueDiligence report with a PROCEED / AVOID verdict.
dana.purpose: Tells you whether an employer is worth your time before you invest in a tailored CV.
howTo: Rex must have found jobs first (composite match_score ≥ 80).
Optionally target one company or job id.
Tick "Force refresh" to re-research even if a dossier exists.
Click "Run Dana" — she writes a Markdown dossier to output/dossiers/.

leo.bio: Resume tailor. Rewrites your master profile to align with each JD (ground-truth only, STAR method), then produces a CV and cover letter in Typst/PDF.
leo.purpose: Produces ATS-aligned application documents per job — but only for PROCEED-vetted, high-match roles.
howTo: Dana must have marked the employer PROCEED.
The job needs match_score ≥ 80.
Optionally target one company or job id.
Optionally pick a Canvas template (classic, compact, technical) or leave blank to auto-pick.
Click "Run Leo" — he writes CV + cover letter (.typ/.pdf/.md) to output/{company}_{role}/.

clara.bio: Application readiness auditor. Matches your real credentials to the role, detects the application channel (Workday / Greenhouse / JobsDB / Direct Email), and exports a hand-in checklist.
clara.purpose: Bridges the gap between "CV ready" and "actually submitted" — the final human step.
howTo: Leo must have produced a CV (cv_status = MATERIALS_GENERATED).
Optionally target one company or job id.
Click "Run Clara" — she stamps Application_Checklist.md and flips application_ready.
